func run(items: [Item]) async {
 for item in items {
  switch item.kind { default: break }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  await save(item)
 }
 for item in items {
  for child in item.children { if child.done { break } }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  await save(item)
 }
 for item in items { await save(item); if item.done { break } }
 for item in items {
  switch item.kind { case .ready: break; default: print(item) }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  await save(item)
 }
}
